neet_phy_u18_t00_4.working: A is true: a thin foil ensures mostly single scattering. R is true: smaller impact parameter gives larger angle. R does not explain why the foil is thin.

neet_phy_u18_t00_5.working: b = (d/2)cot(θ/2); at 90°, cot 45° = 1, so b = d/2 and I is correct. The distance of closest approach gives an upper limit on nuclear size, not a lower limit, so II is incorrect.
